Built-in music player: sign in, sync real liked songs and playlists, and display original lyrics in the world
ui.music.spotifySetup: 先填写你在 Spotify 开发者页面创建的应用 Client ID，并登记下方回调地址；随后在本机浏览器登录。播放通过已激活的 Spotify Connect 设备进行，需要相应账户权限。

Enter your Spotify app Client ID and register the redirect URI below, then sign in using a browser on this PC. Playback uses an active Spotify Connect device and requires the corresponding account permissions.
ui.music.kuwoSetup: 在酷我官方网页完成登录后，手动粘贴该平台的会话 Cookie。只有酷我服务器验证通过后才会连接；本功能不会读取浏览器中的其他账号。
Sign in on the official Kuwo website, then manually paste its session Cookie. Connection requires verification by Kuwo; this feature does not read other browser accounts.
